title: 第19章 保存的意识第20章 收获
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
等孙云醒来时，已经是一天之后的事了，大家也都没有大碍了。孙云感觉，体力恢复的差不多了，只是脑袋还是有点昏沉沉的。
“那蟒呢？”孙云奇怪的问。
“本大人在这！”没等大家回答，水中探出一个脑袋。
“到底是怎么回事，现在可以告诉我了吧？”
孙云感觉很茫然，迫不及待的问道！
“当然可以，事情是这样的……”
巨蟒雷特，看起来心情不错，向孙云解释起来！
原来，巨蟒雷特属于比蒙蟒类，是一种生命悠久的生物，与泰坦一族是战斗伙伴。因为生活环境的变化，繁殖缓慢等愿意，数量越来越少，甚至达到了灭绝的程度。
魔兽、人类、兽人、精灵、泰坦等各族，为争夺生存的空间，形成了纷乱的战争。战斗比的是消耗，很多强大的种族，因为各种各样的原因，慢慢的没落，其中就有泰坦一族。
后来亡灵席卷大陆，外强中干的泰坦，身为一方势力，也参与了抵抗。就这样，为数不多的泰坦战士，纷纷都去了战场，再也没能回来过。只留下一个残疾的泰坦和一条重伤待产的比蒙巨蟒。
重伤的比蒙巨蟒，生下了莽蛋，就去世了。残疾的泰坦，虽然精心照顾蟒蛋，但只成功孵化了雷特这一个蟒蛋。残疾的泰坦，去世之前，把小巨蟒雷特封印在这里。
残疾泰坦临死前说，让雷特等待命中注定的主人，只有找到力量的传承着，雷特才能获得自由。
就这样，巨蟒雷特展开了漫长的等待，已经记不清多少时日了。好在，山洞里有一个湖，里面还是有些弱小的生物的，勉强让雷特不至于饿死。
孙云等蚁，是它等来的唯一智慧生物，让他看到了希望。只有成功认主，才能带他出去，什么狗屁守护兽，他一点兴趣都没有了。
孤独太可怕了，这么多年下来，它一直在尽量选择沉睡。而且，雷特多次有自杀的想法，感觉自己活着没有任何的意义。好在，孙云等蚁出现了，虽然非常非常弱，但只要能让泰坦巨蟒认主，有可能离开这里，其它的已经不重要了。
雷特的实力是六阶，据雷特说他出生就达到了四阶，没有刻意修炼过，自然成长成了六阶。而且，雷特听残疾泰坦说过，比蒙族天生就有越级挑战的能力，所以战力可能更强。
孙云暗暗庆幸自己的幸运，要不是雷特放水，孙云他们的实力，雷特几尾巴就扫死了，都懒的用咬的！
雷特滔滔不绝的一直诉苦，以前它太寂寞了，现在自然珍惜能说话的机会。孙云随着对来龙去脉的了解，对巨蟒雷特的惧怕，慢慢转变变成了可爱，雷特的心境完全是个孩子！
“到了，就是这里！”
随着巨蟒雷特的介绍，它把孙云等蚁带入了核心大殿。

“这么大？”
孙云进入大殿，当时就傻眼了，这也太大了！
首先步入眼帘的是，一个巨大的练武场，四周建立着看台。以练武场为中心，周围有许多大大小小的山洞，大多洞门都已经风化了。
正面有三个石头雕像，左边一个高大健壮的手拿巨棒，显然是巨人族；右边是手拿双锤的矮壮大胡子，应该就是矮人族；中间一个也十分强壮，但比巨人矮了不少，腰围兽皮，一头长发，看起来非常强壮，倒像个猎人。
在雕像的下面有个巨台上，坐着一个已经风化的泰坦，风干的只剩皮包骨了，可以明显看出，他缺一条腿。风化泰坦手里，手里捧着一个箱子，看起来材质不错。
噗通……
孙云想了一下，直接跪下来磕了几个头，
但预想中的出来个虚影，或者说话什么的并没有出现。孙云又围着雕像和风化泰坦，各个角度磕起来，还不时的嘴里念叨着什么。
content_en:
When Sun Yun woke up, it was already a day later, and everyone was fine. Sun Yun felt that his physical strength had almost recovered, but his head was still a little groggy.
"What about the python?" Sun Yun asked strangely.
"My lord is here!" Before anyone could answer, a head popped out of the water.
"What's going on? Can you tell me now?"
Sun Yun felt very confused and couldn't wait to ask!
"Of course, here's the thing..."
Python Leiter seemed to be in a good mood and explained to Sun Yun!
It turns out that the giant python Leiter belongs to the Behemoth Python class, a long-lived creature, and is a fighting partner with the Titan family. Due to changes in the living environment and slow reproduction, the number is getting smaller and smaller, even reaching the point of extinction.
Various races such as Warcraft, humans, orcs, elves, and Titans competed for living space, forming chaotic wars. Fighting is more about consumption. Many powerful races slowly declined due to various reasons, including the Titan race.
Later, the undead swept across the continent, and Titan, a powerful force but a powerful force, also participated in the resistance. In this way, the few Titan warriors went to the battlefield one after another and never came back. Only a disabled Titan and a seriously injured Behemoth Python were left behind.
The seriously injured Behemoth Python gave birth to a reckless egg and died. Although the disabled Titan took good care of the python eggs, he only succeeded in hatching one python egg, Leiter. The disabled Titan sealed the little python Leit here before his death.
Before dying, the disabled Titan said that Leiter should wait for his destined master. Only by finding the inheritor of power can Leiter be free.
In this way, Python Leiter began to wait for a long time, and he can no longer remember how long it took. Fortunately, there is a lake in the cave, and there are still some weak creatures in it, which barely prevents Leiter from starving to death.
Sun Yun and other ants were the only intelligent creatures he waited for, giving him hope. Only by successfully recognizing the owner can he be taken out. He has no interest in any bullshit guardian beast.
Loneliness is so terrible. After so many years, it has been trying its best to choose to sleep. Moreover, Leiter had many thoughts of suicide and felt that his life had no meaning. Fortunately, Sun Yun and other ants appeared. Although they were very, very weak, as long as the Titan Python could be recognized as its master and it was possible to leave here, the rest was no longer important.
Lei Te's strength is level six. According to Lei Te, he reached level four when he was born. He has naturally grown to level six without any deliberate training. Moreover, Leiter heard from the Disabled Titan that the Behemoths were born with the ability to leapfrog challenges, so their combat power may be stronger.
Sun Yun secretly rejoiced at his luck. If Lei Te hadn't betrayed them, Sun Yun and the others would have been so powerful that Lei Te would have killed them with just a few tails, and they wouldn't have even bothered to bite them!
Lei Te kept complaining that he was too lonely before, but now he naturally cherishes the opportunity to talk. As Sun Yun understood the ins and outs, his fear of the giant python Lei Te gradually turned into cuteness. Lei Te's state of mind was completely that of a child!
"Here we are, right here!"
With the introduction of the giant python Lei Te, it brought Sun Yun and other ants into the core hall.
"So big?"
When Sun Yun entered the main hall, he was dumbfounded. This was too big!
The first thing that comes into view is a huge martial arts training ground with stands built around it. With the martial arts training ground as the center, there are many large and small caves around, and most of the cave doors have weathered.
There are three stone statues on the front. The one on the left is tall and strong, holding a giant stick, and is obviously a giant; on the right is a short, bearded man holding two hammers, who should be a dwarf; the one in the middle is also very strong, but much shorter than the giant. It has animal skin around its waist and long hair. It looks very strong, more like a hunter.
There is a huge platform under the statue, sitting on a weathered Titan, with only the weatheredHe was skin and bones, and it was obvious that he was missing a leg. The Weathered Titan was holding a box in his hand, which seemed to be made of good material.
Plop...
Sun Yun thought for a moment, then knelt down and kowtowed a few times.
But the expected shadow or words did not appear. Sun Yun circled around the statue and the Weathered Titan again, knocking against each other from all angles, and muttering something from time to time.
